comparison.objective: Mix flour and liquid into dough while steadying a loose bowl; candidate adjusts and tests a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR coordinates sustained spoon motion with bowl stabilization amid granular contents. Candidate performs fine fastener/collar work followed by guarded impact cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires ≥95% of flour mixed with spill and tip limits. Candidate requires repeated non-bottoming stops under energy, velocity, force, rebound, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Continuous mixing and stabilization test a different physical capability from precision locking and dynamic commissioning.
